record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. AIEC evaluates language models for trustworthiness and performance; NICS tests model safeguards and AI-agent security. Neither has been designated or tasked by the government to test models for their capabilities and risks.

check.language_note: The recorded zh queries use a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged. The additional status review used Mandarin Chinese and English searches; other languages were not exhaustively searched. Search batches for the additional status review, using 1-based positions in check.searches: 3, 4, 5; 6, 7. Each group records the same exact registered URLs found in its combined search results, without attribution to an individual query. Explicit page opens and finds and unverified URL variants are excluded. Groups list the recorded queries; some requests also contained additional queries retained in the research evidence.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The ministry's establishment announcement, later accounts and ministerial transcript confirm government responsibility for AIEC and language-model evaluation. Safety is one item in its trustworthiness criteria, alongside fairness, explainability and other criteria; the transcript also discusses frontier-model progress. These tasks do not by themselves establish the qualifying capability or behaviour-risk assignment. AIEC's methods site lists accuracy, reliability, fairness, privacy and security as its main evaluation items.

record.notes:
Not a UN member; tracked as a territory. The AI Basic Act (passed 23 Dec 2025) requires the Ministry of Digital Affairs to provide AI evaluation and verification tools. AIEC is tracked as a related body because product testing alone does not meet the definition.

Chinese and English government accounts confirm AIEC's language-model evaluations, including Taiwan's language, social context and values. A 2024 ministerial transcript also discusses evaluating frontier models and working with international safety institutes. Separately, the National Institute of Cyber Security published DeepSeek jailbreak tests in February 2025 and AI-agent security tests in May 2026. The AIEC criteria concern trustworthiness and performance; NICS tests protection against attacks. Neither these activities nor the ministerial discussion alone establishes designation under route (a) or an ongoing qualifying public assignment under route (b). AIEC's methods site lists accuracy, reliability, fairness, privacy and security as its main evaluation items; security there means protecting the system against attack and misuse.

related_bodies.name: AI Product and System Evaluation Center (AIEC)
related_bodies.role: It evaluates language models for trustworthiness, local-language performance and Taiwan's social context and values. It is a Ministry of Digital Affairs programme. The ministry works closely with ITRI and the National Institute of Cyber Security and discussed evaluation of frontier models in 2024. Trustworthiness and performance testing do not by themselves establish the qualifying model-evaluation assignment.

related_bodies.name: National Institute of Cyber Security (NICS)
related_bodies.role: It has tested DeepSeek model safeguards and jailbreak resistance, and OpenClaw and NemoClaw agent security. It is an institute under the Ministry of Digital Affairs. These tests do not by themselves establish designation as the national advanced-AI safety institute.

record.identifier_notes: UN M49 overview omits Taiwan as a separate area, but the UN M49 FAQ explicitly permits numeric code 158 for strictly statistical purposes. Retrieved Wikidata Q865 independently gives TW/TWN/158.

closest_body.name: AI Product and System Evaluation Center (AIEC)
closest_body.note: The ministry created AIEC and describes language-model trustworthiness criteria. A ministerial transcript also discusses checking whether frontier models regress or progress. These published tasks do not establish an assigned capability or behaviour-risk remit under the qualifying-body rule. Its methods site lists accuracy, reliability, fairness, privacy and security as its main evaluation items.

claims.text: The ministry's launch announcement says the centre will successively establish certification bodies and testing laboratories next year (113) to provide AI evaluation and verification services.

The ministry's launch announcement says the centre will draw up an evaluation system and evaluation guidelines for AI products and systems, setting the evaluation methods and norms they are to follow.

The ministry says AIEC "published its latest round of evaluation results for domestic and foreign open-source language models", using three indicators highly relevant to Taiwan to examine performance in Traditional Chinese comprehension, Taiwan's social and cultural context, and local knowledge.
The ministry's launch announcement says the centre will provide domestic AI product evaluation services.

The Ministry of Digital Affairs' Administration for Digital Industries says AIEC has continuously published language model benchmark evaluation results since October of year 114 and has so far completed a cumulative total of 131 model tests.

Ministry of Digital Affairs launches the AI Product and System Evaluation Center

excerpts.text: 數位發展部已展開AI評測工作，並在今(6)日於台北科技大學舉辦「AI產品與系統評測中心」啟動活動
excerpts.gloss: The Ministry of Digital Affairs has begun AI evaluation work and held the launch of the AI Product and System Evaluation Center at Taipei Tech today, the sixth.

excerpts.text: 建立語言模型(Large Language Model, LLM)的初步評測項目，涵蓋安全性(Safety)、可解釋性(Explainable)、彈性(Resilient)、公平性(Fair)、準確性(Accuracy)、透明性(Transparency)、當責性(Accountable)、可靠性(Reliability)、隱私(Privacy)及資安(Secure)等10項
excerpts.gloss: Initial LLM evaluation items cover ten areas: safety, explainability, resilience, fairness, accuracy, transparency, accountability, reliability, privacy and security.

excerpts.text: AI評測中心涵蓋制度推動委員會、技術審議小組等架構，將制定「AI產品與系統評測制度」與「AI產品與系統評測指引」，建構我國AI產品與系統遵循之評測方式與規範，提供國內AI產品評測服務，以期保障產品使用者權益，並將陸續於明(113)年成立驗證機構、測試實驗室，提供AI評測與驗證服務，達到促進AI產業正向發展之目的，確保AI技術可被正確使用，提升國內AI產品效能與安全，為我國推動可信任AI環境發展邁出重要的一步。
excerpts.gloss: The AI Evaluation Centre includes structures such as a system promotion committee and a technical review panel, will formulate the 'AI Product and System Evaluation System' and the 'AI Product and System Evaluation Guidelines', establish the evaluation methods and norms that our country's AI products and systems are to follow, and provide domestic AI product evaluation services with a view to protecting product users' rights; it will also successively establish certification bodies and testing laboratories next year (113) to provide AI evaluation and verification services, achieve the aim of promoting the positive development of the AI industry, ensure that AI technology can be used correctly, improve the performance and safety of domestic AI products, and take an important step towards developing a trustworthy AI environment in our country.

sources.title: AIEC publishes latest language model evaluation results

excerpts.text: 數位發展部 AI 產品與系統評測中心（Artificial Intelligence Evaluation Center，下稱 AIEC）於 5 月 1 日公布最新一波國內外開源語言模型評測結果，透過三項與臺灣高度相關的指標「臺灣價值觀」、「高中學測國文」及「高中學測社會」，檢視現行 AI 模型在繁體中文理解、臺灣社會文化脈絡，以及本土知識能力上的實際表現。
excerpts.gloss: On 1 May, the Ministry of Digital Affairs' AI Product and System Evaluation Center (Artificial Intelligence Evaluation Center, hereafter AIEC) published its latest round of evaluation results for domestic and foreign open-source language models, using three indicators highly relevant to Taiwan, 'Taiwanese values', 'high school GSAT Chinese' and 'high school GSAT social studies', to examine how current AI models actually perform in Traditional Chinese comprehension, Taiwan's social and cultural context, and local knowledge.

excerpts.text: AIEC 自 114 年 10 月起持續發布語言模型基準（benchmark）評測成果，至今已累計完成 131 個模型測試。
excerpts.gloss: Since October of year 114, AIEC has continuously published language model benchmark evaluation results, and has so far completed a cumulative total of 131 model tests.
